definitions.RETREAT: a RETREAT root is in the optimal set (Stage 3G.7 definition)
definitions.TARGET_BEARING: offered menu contains a targeted root other than PROTECT (observable, pre-decision)
definitions.OOD: sealed rows with level>=4 and horizon>2 for heads fit on OPEN level<=3

strata.note: The frozen Stage 3G.8 C2 contract evaluates noninferiority on ALL and hidden-state materiality over the Stage 3G.8 population strata (ALL, LOW, MID, HIGH, RETREAT, HORIZON_DEPENDENT, TARGET_BEARING, BYPASS). No stratum is added. Per-stratum noninferiority is reported, not required.

statistics.material: Stage 3G.7 rule: mean hit gain >= .05, paired 95% percentile lower bound > 0 and normalized regret not worse. A claim requires both families (replication); n<100 in either family is NOT_TESTABLE. HARMFUL is the mirror rule.
statistics.noninferiority: One-sided, Bonferroni over the registered NI family, deterministic paired percentile bootstrap with 40,000 resamples: PASS iff hit-deficit upper < .05 and nreg-excess upper < .01; FAIL iff a lower bound reaches a margin; else NOT_TESTABLE.
statistics.bootstrap: deterministic paired percentile, unit row weights, seed STAGE3G8:<key>
statistics.stratumNi: reported with the same per-endpoint alpha; not required
statistics.note: Margins (.05 hit, .01 normalized regret), minN 100, 40,000 paired deterministic resamples, Stage 3G.7 materiality rule, seeds STAGE3G9:<key>. Ten registered NI endpoints -> alpha .005 per endpoint (Stage 3G.8: .00625).

fit.source: Stage 3G.7 OPEN fit set (seed 8013, 320 rows) reused unchanged, hash-verified. Frozen Stage 3G.8 heads are reused; only the diagnostic refit control is fit, on the same rows.

seeds.admission: Unmodified corpusRecord. Families A/B: equal level x horizon-band x objective quotas over fixed sixteen-seed panels in the Stage 3G.7/3G.8 canonical combination order; quota is checked before a record is built; unit weights; no action or outcome oversampling. Cohorts BYPASS_A/B: bands H2-H4, admitted iff the offered t0 menu contains BYPASS, quota 18 per level x band, shortfalls recorded, population weight 0. Record/world/topology hashes disjoint from all prior lineage (through Stage 3G.8 sealed) and across partitions, claimed in partition order A, B, BYPASS_A, BYPASS_B.
seeds.index: combinationIndex = position in the full canonical enumeration of the partition (cell-major, seed, round, objective), independent of admissions; withEquivariance iff combinationIndex % 25 = 0. Parallel workers only pre-compute pure records into a cache; the single canonical admission pass decides every row, so the payload is identical with or without the cache.
seeds.precision: Stage 3G.8 family B S2 normalized-regret bound was .0104 at 2304 inferential rows. Population quota doubles to 192 per cell (4608 inferential rows per family). Margins, minimum n, materiality rule and resampling are unchanged; the per-endpoint alpha is not larger than Stage 3G.8 (.00625).

decisionRules.ROOT_SCORER_HASH_UNCHANGED: S2 scores with the frozen Stage 3G.8 S0 model whose hash equals the OPEN-report hash; a refit of S0 on the reused OPEN rows reproduces it
decisionRules.ROOT_FEATURE_DIMENSION_UNCHANGED: S2 and S0 column vectors have equal length (60); the 36 root-state columns and 6 objective columns are identical for every sealed candidate; only the 18 search columns may differ
decisionRules.BYPASS_EXACTNESS: Typed semantic substitute equals the kernel substitute and the rewired ledger dependsOn graph equals the kernel successor dependsOn graph, for every natural BYPASS root and every fixture; coarse substitute identifiability is re-measured
C2_OBSERVABLE_STATE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_DEMON: 1 PRIMARY_S2_VS_HIDDEN and PRIMARY_S2_VS_RUNTIME NI PASS in A and B (ALL)
2 no replicated MATERIAL HIDDEN_OVER_S2 or HIDDEN_REFIT_OVER_S2 in any required population stratum
4 semantic exactness 1.0 without privileged information (disclosure safety, hidden-health collision preserved under S2 features, poison invariance)
6 no replicated MATERIAL advantage of any audit-only channel (hidden state or learned typed columns) over S2 in any required population stratum
decisionRules.CURRENT_RUNTIME_DECISION_NONINFERIOR: RUNTIME_VS_HIDDEN and RUNTIME_VS_SEMANTIC NI PASS in A and B
decisionRules.CURRENT_RUNTIME_SEMANTICALLY_EXACT: coarse substitute identifiable for every natural BYPASS root
decisionRules.RELATION_INFORMATION_USEFUL_FOR_SEMANTIC: exactness 1.0 AND PRIMARY_S2_VS_RUNTIME PASS in A and B AND SEMANTIC_VALUE never replicated HARMFUL AND LEARNED_OVER_SEMANTIC replicated HARMFUL in a required stratum or in both BYPASS cohorts
decisionRules.STAGE3G_CLOSURE: C1, C3-C8 as certified in Stage 3G.8 and re-verified here (integrity, UNKNOWN safety); C2 from this stage. If C2 fails, the single blocker is C2 with the failing condition named.
